commerce.forbidden: This area is outside your permissions.
commerce.offeringsHint: What is currently on sale. The price shown is the list price, before membership pricing.
commerce.codeHint: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, 2–40 characters.
commerce.name: Name
commerce.currencyHint: Three uppercase letters, ISO-4217 — for example THB.
commerce.priceHint: A whole number of minor units — 199.00 is 19900.
commerce.planPriceHint: A plan's price is data, not a branch in code. Members on that plan see this instead of the list price.
commerce.planPriceUnavailable: This needs at least one offering and one membership plan.
commerce.couponsHint: A coupon is bounded by its validity window, its redemption cap and its minimum subtotal.
commerce.couponCodeHint: Letters, digits and hyphens, 3–40 characters. Stored in upper case.

growth.forbidden: This area is outside your permissions.
growth.ladderHint: A rank is data: metric, comparator, threshold and window. A new rule is a row, never a release.
growth.noQualifications: No qualifications — every member reaches this rank.
growth.name: Name
growth.levelHint: Higher wins: evaluation takes the highest level whose rules all pass.
growth.qualificationsEmpty: No rules yet — everyone would reach this rank.
growth.thresholdHint: Money metrics take minor units. Count metrics take a plain count.
growth.legVolumeHint: A qualifying-lines rule needs this — what one line must reach to count.
growth.evaluateHint: Recomputes every active member from the source data. A rank goes down when the data stops supporting it.
growth.referralsHint: The referral graph is not the team graph: writing here never moves anyone between teams, and moving a team never writes here.

compensation.forbidden: This area is outside your permissions.
compensation.plansHint: A plan is configuration, not code — every bonus is a row here. A twelfth bonus is another row, not a release.
compensation.rulesEmpty: This plan has no rules yet.
compensation.noConditions: No conditions — every active member qualifies.
compensation.payoutUnreadable: This payout is not in a shape this screen can read.
compensation.codeHint: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, 2–40 characters.
compensation.name: Plan name
compensation.currencyHint: Three uppercase letters, ISO-4217 — for example THB.
compensation.ruleFormHint: Every bonus is the same sentence: if the member's metrics pass these conditions, pay a fixed amount or a percentage of a basis.
compensation.bonusTypeHint: A reporting label only — fixed_cash, rank, matching, referral. Nothing in the engine branches on it.
compensation.conditionsEmpty: No conditions — leave it empty and every active member is paid.
compensation.thresholdHint: Money metrics in minor units; count metrics as plain numbers.
compensation.minorHint: A whole number of minor units — 199.00 is 19900.
compensation.percentHint: Up to 100. Rounded once, at calculation.
compensation.capHint: The most this rule may pay one member in one run. Minor units.
compensation.windowNote: A basis window defaults to the run's own period. Lifetime pays for the same sales again in every period, for ever — a plan that really means all-time has to choose it.
compensation.runsHint: A run is a snapshot of one period. Asking twice for the same period returns the same run — a second one would be a second payout.
compensation.runExisted: This period already had a run — it was returned unchanged.
compensation.approveConfirm: Approving freezes this run and records every entry as earned. It cannot be undone. Approve?
compensation.placementsHint: Who is paid under whom. This is its own graph — a member may be referred by one person and paid under another, and neither line follows the other.

automation.forbidden: This area is outside your permissions.
automation.rulesHint: A rule is one sentence: when an event happens, if its conditions hold, then its actions run. An event produced by an automation action never triggers another rule, so rules cannot chain.
automation.ruleFormHint: A rule’s trigger, conditions and actions are fixed once it is created — changing what a rule does would rewrite the meaning of the executions already pointing at it. Its name, priority and status stay editable.
automation.codeHint: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, 2–40 characters.
automation.name: Rule name
automation.triggerHint: Only events this platform emits can trigger a rule; anything else is refused when the rule is saved. Time-based triggers do not exist yet.
automation.conditionsEmpty: No conditions — the rule runs on every occurrence of its trigger.
automation.thresholdHint: Money metrics are minor units — 50000 means 500.00. Counts are plain counts.
automation.payloadPathHint: A dotted path into the event body, for example rewardType.
automation.payloadValueHint: Compared for equality only — never for order.
automation.actionsEmpty: A rule with no actions does nothing. Add at least one.
automation.actionsRefused: Email, LINE, AI, coach, segment, task and workflow actions have no adapter yet and are refused when the rule is saved, rather than looking configured and doing nothing.
automation.courseIdHint: The course identifier (UUID). A course retired later fails at run time, not here.
automation.executionsHint: One row per rule and event, newest first. A replayed event cannot fire the same rule twice.
automation.rewardsHint: Rewards are recognition and stay separate from money. Points and badges are handed to gamification, coupons to commerce, and everything else is a recorded grant.
automation.pointsHint: A count of points, not money.
automation.couponCurrencyHint: ISO-4217, for example THB. Left blank, the tenant currency is used.
automation.configRecorded: A recorded grant — the fulfilment happens off the platform.
automation.grantHint: A manual grant is recorded against the administrator who made it.
automation.grantsHint: Every reward this workspace has granted, newest first. A revoked grant stays on the list as revoked — the row is the history of what was given and taken back.
automation.grantsEmpty: No rewards have been granted yet.
automation.revokeConfirm: Revoke this grant? The row stays as history, and anything already fulfilled — points, a badge, an issued coupon — is not undone.
